biggest_catch: iTalki's official commission table and $30 withdrawal minimum are real, but iTalki publishes no current numeric range for what teachers actually charge - so there is no official current pay to verify.
catches: No current official teacher price range: the '$5-$80/hr typical' figure is dated third-party material, not current official terms.
Official commission table exists (21% single lesson, 19% 5-pack, 17% 10-pack, 15% 15/20-pack, 30% group class) - but without official price data it cannot anchor a payout figure.
Official withdrawal rule: at least $30 in iTalki Credits; iTalki charges no withdrawal fee (express withdrawals excepted); PayPal, Hyperwallet, Payoneer, or bank transfer.
A numeric official FAQ with teacher prices surfaced but was approximately 6,466 days old - far too stale to establish current pay.

c4.evidence: Official commission and $30 minimum exist, but neither is current worker pay; no official numeric pay to anchor.

eligibility: Community Tutors need no degree; Professional Teachers need credentials; application + ID verification required.
maximize: iTalki is rejected here because no current official teacher-price range exists - don't quote third-party '$5-$80' figures as income. If official terms ever publish current prices, sell 10- and 20-lesson packages (commission drops from 21% to 17%/15%) and use 0%-commission trial lessons to convert students; until then, Preply and Wyzant have verifiable official pay.

Set lesson prices and list trial, single, and package lessons.
Teach lessons; iTalki takes its commission per the official table (21% on singles down to 15% on large packages).
Withdraw any time once you hold at least $30 in iTalki Credits; pay figures are not officially stated.
